hypothesis: One-token lazy parsing will improve size by skipping a match when the next-position match is at least two bytes longer.
change_summary: Add optional cl mode with one-byte lookahead; preserve greedy mode and v1 decoder format.
notes: -0.937% size overall; Canterbury -2.261%; encode speed -18.992%; no per-file size regressions; no external Pareto point. Full results: results/exp-0001/.

hypothesis: Independent 64 KiB blocks with raw fallback will eliminate incompressible expansion and reduce match-state memory without unacceptable aggregate regressions.
change_summary: Add v2 cb/clb modes with nine-byte raw-or-LZ block headers and strict version-aware decoding.
notes: Versus v1 lazy: size -4.503%; encode +24.273%; decode +3.549%; encoder RSS -44.828%. Canterbury size +7.106%; raw/scientific/RGB about -11%. Retain v1 for cross-block compression. Full results: results/exp-0002/.

hypothesis: Block-static entropy coding of LZ token payloads will close a meaningful part of the Canterbury and structured-text gap after exact table costs.
change_summary: Add cbh/clbh modes that select the smallest of raw, plain LZ, or serialized-tree Huffman-coded LZ per v2 block.
notes: Versus blocked lazy: size -9.606%; encode -12.902%; decode -20.754%; RSS +4.425%. Canterbury -22.057%; no per-file size regressions; 1.509% larger than gzip-1 and slower. Full results: results/exp-0003/.
